title: 加里奥·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 浅色石质身躯轮廓厚实，金边肩甲与巨大的棱角双翼相互呼应。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Galio is an immense pale petricite sentinel with a pointed horned head, enormous gold-trimmed shoulder plates, massive carved chest, thick stone limbs, and giant angular wings. Preserve his living-statue anatomy and material rather than representing a man in a suit. His eyes are steady, the stone surfaces intact, and the folded wings and grounded feet create a composed monumental silhouette without destruction.
art_direction.scene: A balanced near-frontal full character, subtle contrapposto if anatomically appropriate, silhouette opening into a large quiet paper field. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: petricite ivory, pale gold, cobalt shadow, warm gray; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
